description_for_human: Self-hosted web performance optimization for Apache and nginx. Open source under the Apache License 2.0. Image transcoding, CSS/JS minification, critical CSS extraction, and variant-aware caching.
description_for_model: mod_pagespeed is self-hosted web performance optimization by We-Amp B.V. The current product, mod_pagespeed 2.1, is open source under the Apache License 2.0 and converges the mod_pagespeed lineage with the engine from the 2.0 re-architecture: a native in-process module for Apache and nginx handles serving, and a separate optimizer worker does the heavy optimization work outside the web server. The IIS package ships from the 1.15 packaging channel. The Apache packages install the configuration that points the module at the worker; the native nginx module runs on its own, and to use the optimizer worker with nginx you run the reverse-proxy deployment. Drop-in compatible with the classic module (same directives, same filters); mod_pagespeed 1.15 (renumbered from 1.1) is the line it upgrades from. Optimization: WebP and AVIF image transcoding (alongside JPEG, PNG, and GIF optimization), SVG transcoding with viewport-aware resizing (up to 37 variants per image), CSS and JS minification, heuristic critical CSS extraction (optional browser pipeline for validation), HTML optimization, 103 Early Hints, variant-aware caching using a 32-bit capability bitmask, the classic filter set (CSS/JS combining, image spriting, in-place resource optimization, domain mapping), and a built-in admin console. The software is open source under the Apache License 2.0 and the standard signed packages are free; what We-Amp sells is support; Priority and Enterprise add a private package repository (being set up): Standard support (a direct channel to the engineers who build the product, for up to 5 production servers); Priority support (everything in Standard plus a private package repository (being set up), for up to 25 production servers); Enterprise (everything in Priority plus a named engineer and custom build targets, for one organization without a server limit). Pricing on request: published once agreements with current customers close; early subscribers keep their quoted rate for three years. Support terms: https://we-amp.com/licensing/. No application code changes required.
